title: Full body · 14 September
label: 45-MINUTE RETURN SESSION
coachNote: 45 minutes in the gym, excluding the 10-minute walk each way. The outbound walk is your general warmup; do light practice sets before loaded exercises. Use comfortable loads with about 3–4 reps in reserve. Rest 60–90 seconds. Skip any movement that causes discomfort. Jogging is separate. No previous loads were available, so choose today's loads rather than treating blanks as zero.

exercises.name: 45° leg press
exercises.target: 2 sets × 10 reps · comfortable load · 3–4 reps in reserve
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record plates added and note whether your load includes the sled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record weight per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cable row
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record the machine's displayed load.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.note: Light practice set first. Record weight per dumbbell.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.note: Each set means 10 on the left AND 10 on the right. Enter reps per side (10), not the combined total. Note any difference between sides.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.target: 3 easy pushes · about 20 seconds per push
exercises.note: Each set row is ONE push lasting about 20 seconds. REPS = 1 means one push; it does not mean seconds. Record added load after choosing a comfortable amount, and actual duration in notes. Keep it easy.
